title: Изумрудное ущелье
palette: Deep emerald and moss green, cool weathered grey slate, tiny pale blue stream, warm chestnut timber. No ivory architecture or gold flower carpet.
terrain: A long, irregular cleft landmass, broad forest glades separated by a shallow winding slate ravine. One connected substantial floating terrain slab with dark rooted rock underside, very asymmetric rather than a disk.
landmarks: An off-center thick fallen-tree bridge over the brook; a low wide slate natural arch forming a short open-ended cave; big rounded tree crowns gathered in two groves; fern glade with moss boulders.
road: Wide worn grey flagstone trail with soft earth shoulders, thick timber surfacing only on the bridge.
journey: Weave through a grove, curve inward across the brook, travel through the short slate arch, emerge into a central glade, then bend outward between boulders. The island has room on both sides of the road. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Rounded expressive forest shapes with textured moss and broad painterly leaf masses.
architecture: Two off-center mountain radio homes integrated into the NORTHWEST slate ridge, dark moss-green pitched roofs, rounded copper speaker vents and thick short antenna forks. One low timber/bronze pump workshop on the SOUTHEAST brook bank, clear of bridge and road. A few large readable buildings, not tiny toy clutter. Clear some trees for their pads while keeping the forest world.

title: Коралловый оазис
palette: Coral pink and terracotta sandstone, apricot sand, vivid turquoise water, dusty teal palms and faded red adobe. No white stone castle.
terrain: Broad stepped red-sandstone mesas joined by thick low natural saddles, an asymmetrical many-sided desert landmass with flat tall buttes and a bowl-like oasis depression.
landmarks: A small off-center flat-roof adobe settlement, one turquoise pond with chunky palms, a thick eroded sandstone gate and sculptural wind-carved rock fins. Keep generous areas of open sand.
road: Broad compacted rose-sand road with embedded rust-colored slabs, low dune shoulders, no continuous circular curb.
journey: Thread between sandstone fins, bend through an adobe gate into the interior, sweep beside the pond then reverse the bend toward a broad saddle and the opposite edge. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Chunky sun-baked terracotta forms and stylized layered erosion, large uncluttered warm surfaces.
architecture: A group of two stepped coral-adobe radio homes EAST of the oasis, flat red roofs with thick brass vent stacks and short aerials; a squat eroded sandstone signal/watch tower on the WEST butte with a copper ring receiver. Rounded doors/speaker vents and brass mechanisms connect to the courier world. Desert materials, no ivory village.

title: Аметистовый грот
palette: Violet and midnight indigo rock, luminous lavender amethyst, restrained cyan mineral pools, silver-blue fungi. No green garden or cream building.
terrain: A lopsided faceted open-ravine island with one large open-cut mineral ravine on one side and a lower mineral shelf extending far to the other. Thick connected purple rock mass, not a round platform.
landmarks: Three substantial amethyst crystal clusters, one very short thick stone bridge-like arch with daylight on both sides, a shallow cyan mineral pool, chunky silver-blue mushrooms.
road: Broad muted plum stone paving with a pale lavender mineral seam along one edge, rock shoulders on both sides.
journey: Bend down into the open-cut grotto, pass below its short thick arch, emerge along a mineral pool, change curve direction between crystal outcrops, then cross an interior saddle. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Stylized faceted minerals and smooth sculpted cave walls with controlled soft gemstone glow.
architecture: One low indigo-stone radio research workshop on the NORTHWEST mineral ledge with lavender metal roof and chunky silver/brass vent; two squat crystal-cut courier homes on the SOUTHEAST shelf, short thick antenna forks and circular speaker grilles. Facades visible in OPEN ravine, never long enclosed cave architecture.

title: Осенние ветряные холмы
palette: Burnt orange, russet red, ochre grass, dark timber, muted blue brook and smoke-grey rock. Autumn woodland, not mint/ivory.
terrain: Rolling multi-lobed hills with broad grassy saddles, exposed rust-brown shale underside, low rounded rises spread across an irregular elongated footprint.
landmarks: One off-center timber windmill with four thick broad cloth-covered blades, a small timber footbridge, autumn maples with orange/red crowns, a modest pumpkin patch and a brook. No domed radio house.
road: Wide warm brown packed-earth lane, occasional timber planks and worn ochre cobbles, open grass shoulders.
journey: Wander between two autumn groves, cross the brook, sweep past the windmill on a generous local arc, cut back through a shallow central valley, then head across an open hill. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Warm storybook countryside, broad painted tree crowns and tactile timber carpentry.
architecture: Keep the big off-center timber windmill with broad cloth blades and brass hub. Add a russet timber courier home on the WEST hill and a low red-roof radio workshop on the SOUTHEAST shoulder with copper vent stacks and short antenna. Ochre stone plinths and warm wood, no cream domes. All pads outside the road.

title: Лунный ледник
palette: Glacier blue, pale cyan ice, white snow, cold cobalt cracks and moon-silver metal. Very sparse violet highlights. No beige limestone or coral flags.
terrain: An angular split ice shelf with two broad staggered levels joined by a smooth wide snow ramp, faceted blue frozen underside and a large diagonal fissure.
landmarks: One thick translucent-blue ice arch, an off-center low silver crescent beacon, three chunky frost boulders and a small still frozen lake. Sparse winter shrubs, no cypresses.
road: A broad blue-grey gritted snow trail clearly contrasting with white snow; smooth gentle ramps without stairs, no full-loop edging.
journey: Sweep around a frost boulder, turn inward across the lower shelf, pass under the thick ice arch, curve along the frozen lake, then gradually climb the broad ramp and change heading again. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Clean crystalline winter shapes, soft snow volume and readable thick ice forms.
architecture: Two squat radio homes embedded into NORTHWEST ice ridge above the lake; one moon-silver workshop on SOUTHEAST lobe beyond the lower bend. Frosted blue metal roofs, cobalt doors, warm brass round vents and thick roof antenna forks. Retain low crescent beacon on NORTHEAST with chunky geared base. No tall central tower.

title: Тропические каскады
palette: Bright jade jungle, saturated turquoise water, dark warm volcanic tuff, orange hibiscus accents and reddish palm trunks. No cream village.
terrain: Tall staggered tropical terraces arranged diagonally on a deep irregular island mass, broad vegetated ramps joining shelves, two opaque water ribbons descending as finite tiered waterfalls.
landmarks: Two tiered waterfalls, one thick supported stone bridge over a channel, an off-center low thatched hut, chunky palm crowns and a quiet fern clearing. Keep the road dry and unobscured.
road: Wide dark basalt pavers through jade grass, ochre timber bridge deck, low fern shoulders.
journey: Thread through palms, bend inward behind a short waterfall arch with obvious rock clearance, cross the broad supported bridge, sweep through the fern clearing, then curve down a gentle terrace ramp. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Lush broad tropical forms, saturated foliage and sculptural water ribbons with clear solid edges.
architecture: Upgrade EASTERN thatched hut into radio depot with bamboo/ochre walls, brass vents and one chunky dish. Add two palm-roof mountain courier homes into NORTHWEST terrace and an open-sided timber pump workshop on SOUTHWEST shelf. A short wooden windmill with brass hub on eastern rear shelf if room. Keep all waterfall and bridge clearance open.

title: Грозовой берег
palette: Navy and storm grey, nearly black basalt, blue-green inlet water, weathered brown wood and rusty red nautical accents. No warm ivory garden.
terrain: A low long jagged coastline slab with a diagonal sheltered inlet cutting deeply into the interior, uneven black basalt headlands connected by broad inland land corridors.
landmarks: A short off-center rust-red semaphore mast with thick paddles, low timber rain shelter, sheltered inlet and heavy basalt arch. One small pond with rain ripple relief; no airborne rain streaks or mist hiding geometry.
road: Wide rough slate coastal road changing to thick brown timber decking near the shelter, grey gravel shoulders.
journey: Turn inland between basalt headlands, skirt the deep inlet on alternating broad curves, pass through the heavy arch, cross an exposed grassy interior and arrive beside the shelter. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Bold nautical silhouettes, simplified weathered basalt and damp material sheen, cool overcast material lighting.
architecture: Two low weatherproof radio homes embedded in NORTHWEST basalt headland; NORTHEAST shelter deck becomes a timber/navy-steel radio depot with chunky roof antenna and heavy brass exhaust. One squat rust-red signal/windmill tower on SOUTHEAST rock buttress, thick paddle arms instead of a fine lattice mast. Damp timber, navy roofs and rusty brass.

title: Солнечные поля
palette: Golden yellow fields, fresh light green grass, barn red, rich brown soil, muted sky-blue fountain water and warm tan earth. No dark cypresses or white domes.
terrain: A wide asymmetric farm plateau with shallow diagonal agricultural terraces and rounded loess cliffs with thick grass-root edges. Open fields occupy much more area than buildings.
landmarks: One small off-center red timber barn, two chunky sunflower field patches, a low broad stone fountain, a shallow duckless pond and a few apple trees. Large simple crop masses rather than thousands of tiny flowers.
road: Broad ochre farm lane with gentle wheel-worn relief and short brick-paved courtyard segment; no stairs or continuous circular curb.
journey: Wind between sunflower patches, sweep through the inner fountain courtyard, curve beside the pond, cut across an open middle meadow, then bend toward the barn-side exit. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Sunny stylized farmland with broad friendly forms, matte painted timber and open readable terrain.
architecture: Keep SOUTHEAST red barn, make it a courier/radio workshop with one chunky brass vent and short antenna. Add a low red-timber radio home on NORTHWEST wheat terrace and a squat wooden windmill with brass hub on outer WEST/SOUTHWEST field shoulder. Fountain/pond and sunflower masses remain. Three readable silhouettes, not a central tower.

title: Вулканический сад
palette: Charcoal black basalt, deep brick-red mineral rock, ember orange cracks, red-leaf bonsai and sparse silver-green grass. Calm magical volcanic garden, not dangerous lava flooding the road.
terrain: An irregular horseshoe-shaped caldera mass with a broad solid inner saddle and a low open crater depression; chunky black columnar underside. The road CROSSES the interior saddle and changes direction; never simply follows the horseshoe rim.
landmarks: One off-center red-leaf sculptural tree, a shallow sealed ember mineral pool, thick basalt rock gate and two short opaque pale steam plumes tucked away from the road.
road: Wide cool charcoal stone path with subtle rust-red aggregate and clear lighter ash shoulders, no glowing tile chain.
journey: Thread basalt columns, bend into the inner saddle, pass the red tree, turn through the broad crater floor, then curve under the thick rock gate and leave across a different ridge. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Strong sculpted basalt geometry with controlled emissive cracks and restrained red foliage.
architecture: Basalt/brick-red courier workshop on NORTHEAST high bluff with broad brass chimney and short antenna; one low basalt radio home on WEST rust slab; squat copper turbine/relay on SOUTHEAST ridge outside stone arch. Warm red roofs/copper mechanisms contrast charcoal rock. Sealed ember pool and sculptural red tree remain anchors.

title: Облачная обсерватория
palette: Peach and lavender cloudstone, pearly pink terraces, pale gold instruments, mauve shrubs and cool periwinkle inlays. Soft pastel celestial world, no green/mint Mediterranean garden.
terrain: Stacked broad rounded cloudstone ledges offset diagonally like a sculpted spiral hillside but with a winding cross-island circuit, connected by thick wide gently sloping saddles. No circular race track or concentric rings.
landmarks: An off-center OPEN low gold observatory pavilion with thick ribs, a shallow pearly cloudwell fountain, one lavender natural arch and three sculpted mauve shrubs. No tall castle or central domed tower.
road: Wide muted periwinkle stone-inlaid trail across peach terraces, gentle smooth ramps with no steps; ample pale shoulders.
journey: Bend between offset ledges, travel through the lavender arch into the interior, sweep beside the cloudwell, cross a broad saddle below the gold pavilion, then reverse curve toward a different edge. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Airy sculptural ceramic shapes and satin celestial metals, clear thick modelable structures.
architecture: Preserve SOUTHEAST open low gold observatory pavilion. Add NORTHWEST peach-ceramic radio workshop with lavender roof, chunky brass vents and short aerial; SOUTHWEST mauve courier home; low periwinkle relay plinth on NORTHEAST ledge with one gold dish. Central cloudwell and short lavender stone arch remain. Low legible buildings, no generic castle.
